title: Heptabase Updates - Mobile Task, Collaboration Beta Test, and more!
summary: Heptabase Updates - Mobile Task, Collaboration Beta Test, and more!
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


As the Lunar New Year approaches, our support team will be taking a short break from January 27 to February 2. During this time, we may not be able to respond to messages immediately. However, if you come across any urgent bugs, please let us know through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) so that we can promptly address and resolve them.


---


### Mobile app: Task​


In the latest version, we've introduced the Task feature in the mobile app! Now you can swipe left and right to complete or reschedule your to-dos. Plus, you can long-press on a task to enter selection mode and multi-select tasks to check them off all at once!


---


### Collaboration beta test​


We have been working on collaboration features in the past few months. We’re now entering the internal testing phase and would like to involve some users in our testing process.


If you want to beta-test the early version of our collaboration features, please fill out[this form](https://form.typeform.com/to/AtS6caSv) . We'll let you know once the feature is ready for you, and if you find any issues, you can report them to us through our in-app customer support.


---
